title: Adam & Eve’s Real Origin Story
description:
From clay creation myths to the stories of Adam and Eve, Ninhursag, Enki, and Ninthi, from the Yazidi Tawus/Iblis tale to the Quran’s Satan story, religions didn’t appear out of nowhere—they evolved by borrowing, reshaping, and retelling older myths.

In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we trace the evolution of religions across Mesopotamia, Sumer, Babylon, Egypt, Greece, Hinduism, Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, showing how myths were recycled and rebranded over time. We explore:

How clay myths appeared in Genesis, Quran, Egyptian, Greek, and Sumerian traditions.

The Sumerian goddess Ninhursag, her garden Ednu, and the striking parallels with Eden.

How the Habiru (early Hebrews) transformed Enki’s tale into Adam and Eve.

The Yazidi story of Tawus refusing to bow to man, later rebranded as Iblis/Satan in Islam.

How tiny changes in language and transmission created massive religious divisions and bloodshed.

👉 If you’ve searched for evolution of religions, Adam and Eve origins, clay creation myths, Sumerian mythology, Yazidi Tawus and Iblis, Quran vs Bible myths, ancient Mesopotamian gods, religion history explained — this video uncovers the historical roots behind today’s faiths.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!
